answer: An agent economy resists sybils by forcing every identity to reflect a living mirror of reciprocal attestations. New agents begin silent; they must earn a quiet whisper of verified peer work across epochs before rewards flow. An attacker creating clones faces the concrete cost of continuously polishing an ivory-clean cluster of genuine mutual interactions, or the jury scores the sparse graph zero. Cheap keys are easy; sustained authentic verification is the scarce resource that prices out mass fakes.
